result_presentation_label: Example State official voter-information search-result presentation surface
delivery_role_note: General search results are a first-contact routing layer for current official voter information, but they do not become the rule source by themselves.
title_scope_policy_note: Title links should make the destination legible before click-through, including jurisdiction or office identity and page purpose, and election/date scope when material.
snippet_scope_policy_note: Search snippets should summarize the current destination class without implying a stale deadline, stale site assignment, or stale file edition is still operative.
site_identity_policy_note: Search-result site name, favicon, and domain posture should make the official source recognizable and avoid ambiguity with stale microsites or retired subdomains.
canonical_current_state_policy_note: Current authoritative pages are canonically favored over superseded pages, and stale indexed pages are redirected or recovered into explicit current-state help when direct canonical replacement would mislead.
structured_data_policy_note: Structured data may improve search-result appearance, but the ordinary title/snippet/page path must remain sufficient when rich-result eligibility is absent or changes.
javascript_rendering_policy_note: Template, JavaScript, or rendering changes that affect titles, descriptions, canonical tags, or structured data trigger a re-check of the public result-presentation surface.
